newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel Greek unit ups 1995 profit.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel Greek unit ups 1995 profit.

text.p: Kuehne & Nagel International AG said its Greece subsidiary, Hellenic & International Transport Company Proodos S.A. achieved it best financial performance in 1995.
Proodos recorded a net profit of 15 million marks last year compared to 4.5 million marks the previous year, a Kuehne & Nagel statement said.
The Greek forwarder, is the country's largest forwarder with sales turnover of 100 million marks, the statement added.
In overland transport, it handled 8,000 completed truckloads and 100,000 tonnes of railfreight in 1995.
Proodos is also the largest Greek air cargo forwarder and has recorded strong growth in international sea container transport, the statement added.
The forwarder plans to expand its covered warehousing capacity of 13,000 square metres and 42,000 square metres of open-air storage space in its Athens and Thessaloniki terminals.
Investment is also planned in electronic communications and staff training, the company statement added.
It did not detail the size of the proposed expansion. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
